repository.name: @webex/byods
repository.purpose: Published Node.js SDK for Webex Bring Your Own Data Source (BYoDS). One BYODS instance, built from a Service App client ID, client secret, and organization ID, obtains a Service App token pair from a personal access token or refresh token, keeps it in a caller-replaceable TokenStorageAdapter (one in-memory slot by default), and refreshes the access token when an expired one is read. Its data source client creates, reads, lists, updates, and deletes Webex /dataSources records with that token and can renew a data source JWS on a jittered timer; verifyJWSToken checks a JWS against the Webex identity broker key set and resolves a validity result. BYODS_ENVIRONMENT selects production or integration hosts at construction.

byods-sdk.summary: Published npm package @webex/byods (files: dist). Entry src/index.ts exports BYODS, TokenManager, BaseClient, DataSourceClient, LOGGER, and InMemoryTokenStorageAdapter, and the types TokenStorageAdapter, SDKConfig, and ServiceAppToken; declarations are written to dist/types/index.d.ts. package.json main names dist/module/index.js, which no script in the repository writes (build:src writes dist/index.js), so resolving the package name against a repository build fails. Runtime dependencies: jose, node-fetch, @types/node-fetch. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

webex-access-token-http.summary: POST with a personal access token as bearer and JSON targetOrgId, clientId, clientSecret; or POST form grant_type=refresh_token with client_id, client_secret, refresh_token. Response JSON access_token, expires_in, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_in, token_type. Owned by Webex.

webex-datasources-http.summary: POST, GET, PUT, and DELETE on /dataSources and /dataSources/{id} with the Service App bearer token; list responses wrap records in items. Request and response shapes are mirrored in src/data-source-client/types.ts. Owned by Webex.

webex-idbroker-jwks.summary: JWKS document fetched by jose createRemoteJWKSet for verifyJWSToken, cached per BYODS instance for up to 10 minutes with a 30-second refetch cooldown. Owned by Webex.

jose-jwt.summary: createRemoteJWKSet and jwksCache for the key set, jwtVerify for verifyJWSToken (no issuer, audience, subject, or algorithm options), and decodeJwt for the unverified claims read by the renewal tick.

node-fetch-http.summary: HTTP client loaded with a dynamic import on each request by src/http-utils/index.ts, with an AbortController timeout of 30 seconds.
